contract.listener_failure_isolation: An exception raised by one listener does not prevent delivery to subsequent listeners
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() completes successfully when an individual listener raises an exception
contract.delivery_continuity: Healthy listeners registered for the same event continue receiving the event after another listener fails
contract.registry_stability: A listener exception does not mutate or remove the listener registry
contract.payload_delivery: The original event payload remains available to subsequent healthy listeners
contract.permission_enforcement: Event emission continues to require the emitting plugin events permission
